{
  "test_name": "Ledger_2283_Objection1",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection1\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly_DoesNotCrashGeneratorOrAnalyzer()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public struct PlainGenericStruct<T>\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public string Key { get; set; }\n\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public T Value { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n                {\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public Item<int> Member { get; init; }\n\n                    [Key(2)]\n                    public PlainGenericStruct<string> PlainMember { get; init; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        MetadataReference libReference = CompileToMetadataReference(\"Lib\", libSource);\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CreateCompilation(\"App\", appSource, new[] { libReference });\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? itemSymbol = appCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"Lib.Item`1\");\n        Assert.NotNull(itemSymbol);\n        Assert.Empty(itemSymbol!.DeclaringSyntaxReferences);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? plainStructSymbol = appCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"Lib.PlainGenericStruct`1\");\n        Assert.NotNull(plainStructSymbol);\n        Assert.Empty(plainStructSymbol!.DeclaringSyntaxReferences);\n\n        await AssertGeneratorAndAnalyzerSucceedAsync(appCompilation);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssembly_WithDiagnosticConditions_DoesNotCrashOrLeakDiagnostics()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public struct GenericStructWithDiagnostics<T>\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public T Valid { get; set; }\n\n                    public int MissingKey { get; set; }\n\n                    [Key((string)null)]\n                    public string NullKey { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial class Consumer\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public GenericStructWithDiagnostics<int> Value { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        MetadataReference libReference = CompileToMetadataReference(\"Lib\", libSource);\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CreateCompilation(\"App\", appSource, new[] { libReference });\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? structSymbol = appCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"Lib.GenericStructWithDiagnostics`1\");\n        Assert.NotNull(structSymbol);\n        Assert.Empty(structSymbol!.DeclaringSyntaxReferences);\n\n        await AssertGeneratorAndAnalyzerSucceedAsync(appCompilation);\n    }\n\n    private static async Task AssertGeneratorAndAnalyzerSucceedAsync(CSharpCompilation appCompilation)\n    {\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePack.SourceGenerator.MessagePackGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, result => Assert.Null(result.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning));\n        Assert.NotEmpty(runResult.GeneratedTrees);\n        Assert.NotEmpty(outputCompilation.GetSymbolsWithName(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", SymbolFilter.Type));\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        var analyzer = new MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers.MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer();\n        CompilationWithAnalyzers compilationWithAnalyzers = appCompilation.WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(analyzer));\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await compilationWithAnalyzers.GetAllDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Id == \"AD0001\" || d.Id.StartsWith(\"MsgPack\", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning));\n    }\n\n    private static MetadataReference CompileToMetadataReference(string assemblyName, string source)\n    {\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CreateCompilation(assemblyName, source, Array.Empty<MetadataReference>());\n        using var peStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var emitResult = compilation.Emit(peStream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics.Select(d => d.ToString())));\n        return MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(peStream.ToArray());\n    }\n\n    private static CSharpCompilation CreateCompilation(string assemblyName, string source, IEnumerable<MetadataReference> additionalReferences)\n    {\n        SyntaxTree syntaxTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, CSharpParseOptions.Default.WithLanguageVersion(LanguageVersion.Latest));\n        var references = GetDefaultReferences();\n        references.AddRange(additionalReferences);\n        return CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            assemblyName,\n            new[] { syntaxTree },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n    }\n\n    private static List<MetadataReference> GetDefaultReferences()\n    {\n        var seenFileNames = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);\n        var references = new List<MetadataReference>();\n\n        void TryAdd(string? path)\n        {\n            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) && File.Exists(path) && seenFileNames.Add(Path.GetFileName(path)))\n            {\n                references.Add(MetadataReference.CreateFromFile(path));\n            }\n        }\n\n        TryAdd(typeof(object).Assembly.Location);\n        TryAdd(typeof(MessagePack.MessagePackObjectAttribute).Assembly.Location);\n        TryAdd(typeof(MessagePack.MessagePackSerializer).Assembly.Location);\n\n        if (AppContext.GetData(\"TRUSTED_PLATFORM_ASSEMBLIES\") is string tpa)\n        {\n            foreach (string path in tpa.Split(Path.PathSeparator))\n            {\n                TryAdd(path);\n            }\n        }\n\n        return references;\n    }\n}\n"
}
